crossRefs.note: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob.
translations.bsb: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
translations.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
translations.asv: O Jehovah God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
